title: Local-Unitary Rigidity and Quantitative Rounding for Stabilizer AME States
description: For every prime power q and m≥2, this preprint proves that every product-unitary intertwiner between stabilizer AME(2m,q) states is Clifford on each party. Any (m+1)-party marginal reconstructs the complete local Weyl frame, yielding a minimum-support atlas and factorwise rigidity for transversal encoder conversions. A leakage-aware three-region cleaning and Weyl–Fourier argument gives 8ε Clifford rounding throughout the certified radius Θ(min{p⁻¹,q⁻¹ᐟ²,n⁻¹ᐟ²}); the remaining product-Pauli correction is the exact affine-character boundary.
